operations.name: list_jobs
query_shapes: SELECT * FROM contracts WHERE CASE WHEN json_valid(terms) THEN json_extract(terms, '$.representative.near_account') END = ? OR CASE WHEN json_valid(terms) THEN json_extract(terms, '$.contractor.near_account') END = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM platform_agents WHERE organization IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))

SELECT contract_id,state,judgment_id FROM job_submissions s
      WHERE contract_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) AND revision =
      (SELECT MAX(revision) FROM job_submissions WHERE contract_id = s.contract_id)
SELECT contract_id,id FROM judgments WHERE outcome = 'pending' AND contract_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
SELECT * FROM payout_attempts WHERE contract_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) ORDER BY created_at DESC,rowid DESC

SELECT contract_id,organization,kind,state,request_id,confirm_url FROM owner_steps
      WHERE contract_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) OR
      (contract_id IS NULL AND organization IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))) ORDER BY created_at DESC,rowid DESC
